passages.original: Ex hujus autem dictis hoc nos consequenter observamus : qui fieri potuit ut is, qui pone januam ager decumberet, tunc steterit, liturgiam celebrant, ac oblationem fecerit? Aut qui potuit oblatio apposita esse, cum intus essent catechumeni? Si enim intus erant cate- chumeni, nondum oblationis tempus erat. Haec, ut dictum est. aiebat episcopus Athanasius. et ex ipsis monimentis palam faciebat, iis (2) qui cum eo erant affirmantibus, nec Ischyram umquam in Ecclesia catholica fuisse presbyterum, nec in ecclesiasticis conventibus presbyteri locum habuisse.
passages.english: From what this man said, we consequently observe this: how could it have happened that he who was lying sick behind the door was at that time standing, celebrating the liturgy, and making the offering? Or how could the offering have been set out when catechumens were inside? For if catechumens were inside, it was not yet the time of the offering. These things, as has been said, Bishop Athanasius stated, and he made it plain from the records themselves, with those who were with him affirming it, that Ischyras had never been a presbyter in the Catholic Church, nor had held the place of a presbyter in the assemblies of the Church.
passages.notes: "celebrant" is read as "celebraverit" (or "celebrans"), "celebrating"; the printed form appears corrupt. The "(2)" after "iis" is a footnote mark and has been omitted.
